title: byte ranges (usize,usize) not serialization-stable across 32/64-bit platforms
description: ParsedPart.header_range and body_range are (usize, usize). usize is 4 bytes on 32-bit targets and 8 bytes on 64-bit targets. ParsedPart implements Serialize+Deserialize, which callers use to persist or transmit part metadata. A ParsedPart serialized on a 64-bit system and deserialized on a 32-bit system will silently produce wrong offsets. On 32-bit, messages larger than 4 GB cause overflow. The design doc says callers store ParsedMessage however they like; the serialization hazard is entirely implicit and undocumented.
